analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — ADP dip, US-session recovery, $65K touch at the reference close

August 5, 2026 produced the defining technical event of the step-aside period. The 20:00-21:00 UTC reference close candle (Crypto.com 1h verified data): open $64,848.19, high $65,044.22, low $64,806.29, close $64,830.30, volume 112.19 BTC. BTC exceeded the $65,000 step-aside threshold for the first time since July 24 — during the exact measurement window — then closed at $64,830.30, leaving a gap of $169.70.

### Session candle structure (verified Crypto.com 1h data)

| UTC 1h Candle | Open | High | Low | Close | Vol (BTC) | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 00:00 | $64,103 | $64,192 | $63,981 | $63,995 | 46.2 | Midnight open |
| 13:00 | $64,328 | $64,420 | **$63,868** | $64,412 | **294.1** | ★ ADP reaction — day low |
| 14:00 | $64,412 | $64,587 | $64,290 | $64,474 | 250.3 | Recovery begins |
| 16:00 | $64,390 | $64,773 | $64,381 | $64,671 | 182.2 | US regular session |
| 19:00 | $64,797 | $64,950 | $64,783 | $64,850 | 46.2 | Approaching $65K |
| **20:00** | $64,848 | **$65,044** | $64,806 | $64,830 | 112.2 | ★ Reference close — first $65K cross |

Pattern: the ADP release at 12:15 UTC triggered the day's low ($63,868 at 13:00 UTC) before a progressive 7-candle recovery through the entire US session to the $65,044 peak at the reference close.

### Trend — five-session ascending reference close channel

Reference close sequence:
- Aug 1: $62,659 (gap $2,341)
- Aug 2: $63,439 (gap $1,561)
- Aug 3: $63,789 (gap $1,211)
- Aug 4: $64,352 (gap $648)
- Aug 5: $64,830 (gap $170)

Five consecutive improving reference closes. The channel describes an ascending staircase: each session's reference close is higher than the prior session's day high. The momentum is building toward $65,000 organically.

### Volume — ADP candle dominated; US session confirming accumulation

Total session volume through reference close: ~1,662 BTC. Peak: 13:00 UTC ADP candle at 294.1 BTC (17.7% of total day volume in one hour). The ADP spike volume was two-directional: sellers on recession fears (causing the $63,868 low) and buyers on rate-cut hopes (causing the rapid recovery within the same candle). The reference close candle (20:00 UTC, 112.2 BTC) was elevated for a late-session hour, confirming that institutional buyers were active at the $65,000 threshold level.

### The $65,044 touch — demand confirmed, options resistance identified

The $65,044.22 high tells us three things: (1) buy orders above $65,000 exist and were filled — this is not a theoretical level; (2) the resistance at $65,000 is from options gamma (dealers short $65,000 calls hedge by selling when price rises, creating mechanical resistance) rather than fundamental sellers; (3) the pullback from $65,044 to $64,806 low within the same candle is a gamma-barrier bounce, not a trend reversal — 50-EMA ($64,850) sits just below the threshold, adding a second layer of resistance that BTC briefly penetrated.

### ★ Strongest support — $64,352 (August 4 reference close / ascending channel floor)

Evidence:
1. The ascending reference close channel has a clear floor: every session's reference close has exceeded the prior session's — $64,352 (Aug 4) is the most recent confirmed level
2. A break below $64,352 would widen the gap above $600, reversing four sessions of narrowing — technically significant
3. ETF buyers who accumulated at $63,800-$64,400 on Aug 4 and Aug 5 have cost basis below $64,352
4. The 20-day EMA (~$64,400) sits near this level, creating a technical floor cluster

### ★ Strongest resistance — $65,000 (step-aside threshold + 50-day EMA cluster)

The $65,000 level has now been the reference close ceiling for 11 consecutive sessions (July 24-August 5). Evidence:
1. Framework self-reference: $65,000 is the step-aside threshold — institutional framework accounts will not re-enter until this level closes above it
2. 50-day EMA (~$64,850) sits below $65,000, adding technical resistance — BTC must clear both simultaneously
3. Options OI: $65,000 call writers hold short-gamma positions that create mechanical selling pressure as price approaches the strike
4. But: today's $65,044 intraday cross proves the level is NOT impenetrable — it was breached for the first time since July 24. The options gamma resistance is finite.

### What clears the step-aside

The framework requires SIMULTANEOUSLY: (1) reference close > $65,000; AND (2) positive net ETF flows on the same calendar day. Condition 2 has been met for two consecutive days ($170.3M Aug 4, $211.5M Aug 5). Condition 1 remains the gating item: $169.70 gap as of Aug 5 reference close. NFP Friday (Aug 7, 12:30 UTC = 8:30am ET) is the next catalyst that can drive Condition 1. A soft NFP (<100K, continuing the ADP/June trend) would: (a) weaken the dollar, (b) reduce rate-hike probability to near-zero, (c) trigger risk-on in all assets including BTC, and (d) push BTC through $65,000 in the US morning session. If Aug 5 ETF flows ($211.5M) are confirmed as a baseline, NFP would only need to clear Condition 1 on Aug 7's reference close to trigger re-entry.

What invalidates re-entry: hot NFP (>150K) gaps BTC down on August 7 morning, re-expanding the gap to $2,000+, and the step-aside continues.
